text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I've sent Dana the ticket list in her DM. I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines tickets in Moss's notes:

- **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (5 Oct 2025). Thea Ramaswell opened it about kiosk text messages at the Eau Claire gatehouse: drivers weren't getting their dock-door assignments. It was patched on 4 Oct and Thea confirmed the fix on 5 Oct.
- **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet" (undated). Thea logged it because gatehouse barcode scanners couldn't read trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support for firmware testing.

I read all six of Moss's notes. The other QFL mentions don't give a ticket number. The tickets in the Central notes (#4409, #4412, FR-882) belong to Marrow accounts, not QFL. I also warned Dana that "Quarendon Freightways" in Marcus's note is a competitor with a similar name, not our customer.

**The list may be incomplete.** The knowledge brain (gbrain) refused my search. Its connection isn't tied to any one member, so it read nothing. I fell back to the files Dana can open herself, and I didn't search channels, so there may be QFL tickets elsewhere. I told Dana this. Whoever runs the gbrain server would need to run this to fix it: `gbrain auth rescope --token … --member <MEMBER>`.
